ruleRoutingGuidance.belongs: everything specific to this repository and portable nowhere else, the shell and the repo-wide working rules, and the checks, skills and tasks carrying them
ruleRoutingGuidance.excludes: what is specific to one study — that study's pack (nor-study); anything true beyond this repo — a canon pack, proposed upstream

env.label: Python imaging stack (numpy, scipy, pillow, matplotlib) and the page tests' Pyodide
env.setup: python3 -m pip install --quiet --root-user-action=ignore -r requirements.txt && python3 -m pip install --quiet --root-user-action=ignore --ignore-installed pillow && npm install --silent --prefix web-tests pyodide@314.0.7
env.probe: python3 -c "import numpy, scipy, PIL, matplotlib" >/dev/null 2>&1 && test -f web-tests/node_modules/pyodide/package.json
